_comment: Curated allowlist for wire-shape Gate 5 (audit-surface binding). Every entry is an SDK @JsonProperty field with NO backing property in the pinned OpenAPI schema - i.e. named, tracked debt. Entries here MUST carry a note naming the tracking issue. The gate fails on any unlisted unbound field and on any stale entry, so this file can only ever shrink toward empty. See scripts/wire_shape/validate.py.

AuditLogEntry.query_summary: Never served on the 9.x line; deprecated in-model, removal rides the next major (getaxonflow/axonflow-enterprise#3254). The wire carries query/query_hash instead.
AuditLogEntry.success: Never served on the 9.x line; deprecated in-model, removal rides the next major (getaxonflow/axonflow-enterprise#3254). policy_decision 'allowed' replaces success=true.
AuditLogEntry.blocked: Never served on the 9.x line; deprecated in-model, removal rides the next major (getaxonflow/axonflow-enterprise#3254). policy_decision 'blocked' replaces blocked=true.
AuditLogEntry.risk_score: Never served on the 9.x line; deprecated in-model, removal rides the next major (getaxonflow/axonflow-enterprise#3254). No wire equivalent.
AuditLogEntry.latency_ms: Never served on the 9.x line; deprecated in-model, removal rides the next major (getaxonflow/axonflow-enterprise#3254). response_time_ms is the real latency field.
AuditLogEntry.policy_violations: Never served on the 9.x line; deprecated in-model, removal rides the next major (getaxonflow/axonflow-enterprise#3254). policy_details carries violation context.
AuditLogEntry.metadata: Never served on the 9.x line; deprecated in-model, removal rides the next major (getaxonflow/axonflow-enterprise#3254). The wire carries policy_details/security_metrics instead.

AuditSearchRequest.request_type: The 9.x server does not read this filter (silent no-op); deprecated in-model in favor of action, removal rides the next major (getaxonflow/axonflow-enterprise#3254). Still sent on the wire, harmless.
